g.text: Synthetic timing example: laser 100 Hz; aerosol τ = 2 ms; extraction 40 kHz; stored bins 1 ms.

g.text: Each 1-ms bin contains 40 extraction cycles in this gap-free example. A bin splits/averages an aerosol event; it does not create new ions.
